findings.note: Covers' model for the Oct 28 Nuggets-Pelicans game projected DeRozan for about 3.2 assists and made no strong call on assists. Books then had his line mostly at 3.5, so an even-money-or-better Over 2.5 now may mean the market expects less from him. Check his current role and injury status.
In the Oct 28, 2026 game at New Orleans, the same matchup and venue, the official box score shows DeRozan with 5 assists in about 26 minutes, clearing 2.5, even though he shot 1-for-6.
A CBS analysis of his August 2026 signing said Denver's offense runs through Jokic's playmaking and expected DeRozan to mainly lead the bench as a scorer, which could limit his assist chances.
